init.title: Fader light targets
init.description: Choose a dimmable light or light group for each fader. Clear a field to disable its mapping. Changes sync both ways. The light's brightness sets the channel volume at startup and after reconnecting; this also changes audio volume.

data_description.brightness_smoothing: Fade duration in seconds for lights that support transitions. Start with 0.2 s; increase for softer changes, or set 0 for instant changes.

error.duplicate_light: Choose a different light for each fader.
